events.description: Two players (one in red, one in white/blue) engage in mutual physical combat near the boards in the offensive zone, involving grappling, punching, and falling to the ice, with referees intervening by 7.0s.
Two players (one in red jersey #90, one in white/blue jersey #18) engage in mutual physical combat near the goal crease, involving grappling, shoving, and punches while referees attempt to intervene.

Two players (red #90 and white/blue #18) engage in a sustained physical altercation in the offensive zone, involving repeated punches, grappling, and shoving while referees attempt to intervene. The fight persists across multiple frames without separation.
Two players (one in red #90, one in white/blue #18) engage in a sustained physical fight near the face-off circle, involving punching and grappling, with referees intervening.
After the initial fight subsides, the red player (#90) delivers a punch to the downed white/blue player (#18), who is on the ice and unable to defend himself.

Two players (one in red #90, one in white/blue) are engaged in a prolonged physical altercation on the ice, involving grappling, shoving, and repeated attempts to knock each other down; referees intervene but the struggle continues across multiple frames.
During the fight, the player in red (#90) repeatedly strikes or pushes the opponent who is on the ice or attempting to rise, constituting attacks on a temporarily helpless victim.

Two players (red #17 and blue/white #69) engage in a physical confrontation near the boards, involving grappling, shoving, and body checking; one player is knocked down at 20.5s and remains on ice while the other continues aggressive contact until referees intervene around 23.0–23.5s.

After the initial fight subsides, the red-jerseyed player (#17) delivers a deliberate slash or stick swing to the downed blue/white player (#69) who is lying on the ice and unable to defend himself, constituting abuse of a helpless victim.

Two players engage in a sustained physical altercation along the boards: the player in red (No. 17) and the player in white/blue (No. 69) grapple, push, and wrestle each other repeatedly, culminating in both falling to the ice at ~31.0s. The interaction involves mutual grappling, shoving, and body checking without clear separation, consistent with on-ice fighting.

Multiple players from opposing teams engage in a physical altercation near the boards, involving shoving, grappling, and at least one player being knocked to the ice; referees intervene to separate them.

A player in red (No. 90) is on the ice and appears helpless while another player (No. 17) delivers a punch or strike to him; this occurs during the broader fight but constitutes a distinct act of attacking a downed opponent.
